data_fields.name: owned_instances_per_leader
data_fields.donor_constant: 1 (refuse entry while the other instance is occupied)

data_fields.name: level_gain_per_player
data_fields.donor_constant: 7 per player on a base of 100

best_idea: Give each dungeon run its own server-only instance id while every client keeps asking for the shared skin zone, and close the run through one presence ledger plus a grace timer that an entering player cancels and an empty leave re-arms.
decision_why: The instance shape (shared skin id, server-only instance id, one owned instance per leader, presence ledger with grace timer) fits zones-as-data and server-verified kills; the donor's counter, re-arm gap, creation-order and null-path defects are fixed in the sketch; GPL-2.0-or-later so clean-room only.
acceptance: Server test: two groups enter the same dungeon skin and get different instance ids and zone ids; an enemy killed in group A is still alive in group B; when group A's last member leaves with no enemy alive, the instance is removed on the next tick and resolveZone returns undefined for its skin zones.
